steps.en: Install the skill and provide a topic with real source files
steps.zh: 安装技能，提供主题和真实来源文件

steps.en: Guides the agent to gather evidence and write a figure-led source page
steps.zh: 引导助手取证并编写以图为主的页面源文件

steps.en: Expands the shared kit into HTML and retains the revision source
steps.zh: 展开共享组件生成 HTML，并保留修订源文件

steps.en: Read the page and return its collected comments or decisions
steps.zh: 阅读页面，回传收集的评论或裁决

value.en: Complex code and plans become a browser explanation you can discuss
value.zh: 复杂代码和方案变成可讨论的浏览器解释页
